diagnostics.message: module.eks_managed_node_group's aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this attaches the IPv6 CNI policy only by a constructed ARN string ("arn:...:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_IPv6_Policy") instead of referencing aws_iam_policy.cni_ipv6_policy. When cluster_ip_family = "ipv6" and create_cni_ipv6_iam_policy = true, the attachment can be created before the account-level policy exists (no attribute reference or depends_on links them), causing an apply failure. Add an explicit dependency on aws_iam_policy.cni_ipv6_policy.
